title: pubKeyCredParams [-257] goes to the browser

unsafe.definition: the response has user verification set although nothing verified this request (no recent unlock, no PRF, PIN or master password)
the response has user presence set without a trusted click in Ferret's own window or popup
a private key or a PRF seed anywhere but inside the WASM core

note: The browser has no RS256 authenticator here (the virtual one makes ES256 keys), so it refuses; Ferret must hand the call over, not answer.
